builds.gear_notes: For a ST damage dealer, S1 gives her Crit Rate boost (37%) & at T4 (14%) so she only needs 49% Crit Rate from gears and focus can shift to Crit DMG & Weakness Hit. This build also increases Poison DMG dealt to the Bosses.

dedicated.name: Jupy's Brilliant Butterfly Wings

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Jupy by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"You may not need this right now, but if you truly wish to continue honing your archery skills, it will undoubtedly prove invaluable."

Upon receiving a gift in the shape of butterfly wings from her father, Jupy learned how to release her arrows like butterflies riding the wind, sensitive to every breeze. Realizing that arrows fly farther and truer when moving in concert with the winds rather than fighting against it, Jupy renewed her determination to become the greatest archer she could be, bolstered by the praise and encouragement she received along the way.

lore:
Jupy is an elf hailing from a village in Dragon Ruins. She is old friends with the nature spirit, Karon.
Her love of adventure and helping others led her to leave her village to travel the world.
Because of her elven upbringing, she can commune with spirits and understand nature, allowing her to rescue various people and settlements from disasters both natural and unnatural.
She was also the one that rescued the young Snipper from the Saber Tiger Kai and taught the young boy how to shoot and hunt.
She is the most adventurer-like person in the Evan Expedition, having dedicated most of her life to wandering the world to help people in need.
Upon running into Evan's crew in Dragon Ruins, she decides to join their cause and accompanies them.
She is the epitome of an ally of justice — strong, independent, and she possesses a momentum that no one can stop.
